canos_pf_loss_correction.detail: The PFDelta README at 0fb3aeda states that constraint_violations_loss_pf incorrectly calculated reactive-power mismatch and line-branch-flow mismatch, and that the bug has been fixed. Full reproduction uses that corrected implementation. Figure 4 reused the previously published PFDelta baseline numbers, so retrained CANOS-PF can differ from those bars. The correction is not reverted.

std_convention: Sample standard deviation with Bessel correction (numpy.std ddof=1), matching torch.Tensor.std in scripts/test_error.py.
metric: Mean over samples of the mean over buses of sqrt(dP^2 + dQ^2), in per unit on a 100 MVA base.
